# Atabek Raimov Personal Brand Model v1

> **SUPERSEDED on 2026-08-30 by `DEC-864` and `docs/ssot/RAIMOV_WHOLE_PERSON_BRAND.md`.** This file is retained for decision history. Do not use its Clinical Case Club sequencing as current canon. Valid operator, consent, evidence and Academy-gating boundaries continue through the new SSOT.

## Canonical position

**RAIMOV DENTAL is Atabek Raimov's personal expert platform.** Its public role is to demonstrate and commercialise Atabek's work as a **clinical architect of complex dental cases**. It is not a generic clinic catalogue, a lifestyle influencer feed or an Academy presented as already operating.

The platform must make Atabek's clinical judgement legible: diagnosis, interdisciplinary case design, decision trade-offs, sequencing, handoffs and long-term observation. Public claims remain limited by `RAIMOV_PUBLIC_PROFILE.md`, evidence, patient consent, rights and medical review.

## Product ladder

| Audience | First product | Current contract |
|---|---|---|
| Patients | **RAIM SMILE Second Opinion** | A structured entry for complex, contradictory or high-stakes treatment plans. It does not promise personal treatment by Atabek and routes care to the disclosed licensed operator. |
| Doctors | **Raimov Clinical Case Club** | The first professional product: gated case-based learning focused on clinical reasoning and interdisciplinary decisions. It is not accreditation, certification or a substitute for formal education. |
| Future professional education | **Raimov Academy** | A later stage only after a documented methodology, demonstrated demand, an approved programme, faculty/reviewer ownership, evidence and legal/release gates. |

## Brand flywheel

```text
complex cases
→ evidence of clinical reasoning
→ Clinical Case Club
→ professional trust and referrals
→ new qualified complex cases
```

Patient acquisition and professional education must have separate routes, forms, consent wording, analytics and review gates. A patient case cannot become teaching or marketing material without explicit case-level consent, de-identification, rights and clinical review.

## Surface ownership

- `raimovdental.com`: personal expert platform and master routing surface.
- RAIM SMILE Second Opinion: patient-first product authority remains `docs/raimov/patient-funnel/RAIM_SMILE_SECOND_OPINION_PRODUCT.md`.
- Raimov Clinical Case Club: professional-first product contour is `docs/raimov/professional/clinical-club/`.
- Raimov Academy: future education contour is `docs/raimov/academy/`.
- Expert Dental Studio: current operating clinic and current Bishkek medical operator; it is not silently converted into the personal-brand website.
- BALAM: separate pediatric brand/contour governed by its existing SSOT; this model does not change it.

## Status and release boundary

This decision changes strategy, routing and file ownership only. It does not create a public Clinical Case Club route, enrolment, dates, price, curriculum, certificates or Academy. It does not change site runtime, RAIM SMILE operator rules, BALAM runtime or production copy by itself.

`NO_RUNTIME_CHANGE` applies to v1 documentation adoption. Any public implementation requires a separate scoped release with approved copy, evidence, medical/legal review, tests, merge, deploy and live smoke.
